listing.name: Rock Band Blitz — rb-blitz-xenon-recomp (gabrielofavero)
listing.summary: Upstream claims boots, renders2D/3D and finishes songs. Updated feature table claims Vulkan compatibility and RhythmVerse wiring done; shader/performance and widescreen work remains. Windows prerelease/soft-launch text is not a currently observed public release, and no Portcove runtime qualification was performed. Original files and setup are described below. Portcove has not verified setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Own Xbox360 RockBandBlitz package or extracted contents; local build needs game/default.xex. Exact region/revision and executable digest not established. Optional Ultimate mod is not required; PS3 assets only for an unimplemented optional button scheme.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Windows local source build: LLVM/Clang, CMake3.25+, Ninja, VisualStudioBuildTools/WindowsSDK, own game/default.xex; upstream repair/SDK patch steps then two build passes, outputs rb_blitz.exe. README advertises a Windows prerelease installer, but the current public Releases API returned zero records; no installer offer established. Linux/macOS/mobile remain planned.
